summary: Full-stack testing of NurseConnect Hospital Console (iteration 4). Backend regression: existing 22/22 tests (test_security_live.py 10 + test_nurse_flows.py 12) all pass — RLS is intact. Added /app/backend/tests/test_hospital_flows.py (13 tests) covering hospital-to-hospital isolation on job/application/interview, cross-hospital PATCH 403, nurse snapshot fields on applications, interview scheduling + status transition, closed job hidden from /api/public/jobs, nurse-cannot-PATCH-job, hospital profile create + hospital_license doc round-trip — all 13 pass. Frontend Playwright covered: unauth /hospital/dashboard → /login, hospital register lands on dashboard with 0-stats, profile save + persistence + verification Pending badge, job draft vs publish state badges (Draft/Published), candidates page shows nurse-snapshot (name, qualification, experience, location, verification pill, match-% badge, Applied status), shortlist changes status to Shortlisted, schedule interview dialog (date/time/type/link/notes) creates interview + moves app to interview_scheduled + shows on /hospital/interviews, Select puts app on /hospital/hired and increments Hired stat to 1, sidebar logout returns to /login, nurse→/hospital/dashboard shows 'Hospital access only' and hospital→/nurse/dashboard shows 'Nurse access only', mobile 390x844 hamburger opens sheet with hospital-mobile-nav-*, no horizontal overflow on dashboard, closed job disappears from /api/public/jobs.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users'. Non-blocking a11y warning only — fires on schedule-interview-dialog and/or candidate-details-dialog. Wrap the title in VisuallyHidden or add a real DialogTitle.

action_items: OPTIONAL a11y: add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden-wrapped title) inside ScheduleDialog and candidate-details-dialog to silence Radix DialogContent warning.
critical_code_review_comments: JobForm.save() sends published=false + approved=false + status='draft' on Save Draft, and published=true + approved=true + status='active' on Submit. Since backend requires published+approved+status=active for public visibility, this correctly hides drafts and there is no admin-approval gate — matches the note that 'Pending Approval' state is UI metadata only. Consistent with the request.

Nurse snapshot fields (nurse_name/qualification/experience_years/departments/location/city/phone/verification_status/preferred_shift/expected_salary/preferred_location/accommodation_required) are accepted by generic POST /api/application and returned by RLS-scoped GET /api/application to the owning hospital. Verified data integrity end-to-end in test_hospital_flows.test_hospital_a_reads_application_snapshot.
Hospital-to-hospital isolation is enforced by RLS: hospital B cannot list, GET, or PATCH hospital A's jobs / applications / interviews (403). Verified across 5 tests.

Job close via PATCH {status:'closed', published:false} correctly hides the job from /api/public/jobs and blocks new applications with 400/403/404 — confirmed in test_job_close_hides_from_public and test_nurse_cannot_apply_to_closed_job.

Cross-role guards work at the React router layer via HospitalArea / NurseArea (rendering data-testid=not-a-hospital-message / not-a-nurse-message). Since these are client-side guards, security still rides on backend RLS — which is correctly enforced.
Minor a11y: Radix DialogContent warning as noted above. Purely a screen-reader warning; no functional impact.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested hospital-console flows verified via Playwright)

test_credentials: No seeded accounts. Ephemeral TEST_<uuid>@example.com / StrongPass123! nurse+hospital pairs are created inside each test. Admin bootstrap secret in /app/backend/.env if needed (not used this iteration).
seed_data_creation: None persisted intentionally per user rule.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_hospital_flows.py + test_nurse_flows.py + test_security_live.py together give full RLS + flow coverage. When testing UI: hospital pages use HospitalLayout with prefixed hospital-mobile-nav-* testids (no duplicate-testid issue that nurse layout has). ScheduleDialog fires a Radix a11y warning about missing DialogTitle — it's non-blocking and shows on schedule-interview-dialog / candidate-details-dialog. Job 'Pending Approval' state is UI metadata only and not reachable via UI (Submit publishes directly) — do NOT flag as a bug. Applications created before iteration 4 have no nurse snapshot and will show 'Candidate' fallback on the Candidates page.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
